versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Figma Design Review skill.

- Provides a structured PM design review process focused on requirements and user flow coverage.
- Outputs include requirements coverage check, UX concerns, open questions, and explicit approval status.
- Emphasizes requirements-based review—clearly separates requirements coverage, PM concerns, and open issues.
- Enforces quality checks and explicit anti-patterns to improve handoff readiness and reduce miscommunication.
- Example trigger phrases included for easy usage.
